reason: Remaining gap: the string to sign is not published. The runtime now has an rsa_sha256 (PKCS#1 v1.5) signing mode, but Sam's Club Connect Ads API's WM_SEC.AUTH_SIGNATURE is 'A Base64-encoded RSA-SHA256 signature … The client must sign the canonical request string using the private .pem key', and both the signature and WM_CONSUMER.intimestamp are to be produced with 'the signature generator code shared by Sam's team' (https://developer.samsclub.com/API/authentication/, re-read 2026-09-25; the Curl/Java/Node JS/Python samples only show '<Auth signature as generated using signature generator code>'). Without the canonical string the signature cannot be reproduced. Access is limited to onboarded platform partners, who also receive the consumer id, key version and Bearer auth token by e-mail.
